note: Facts are copied from the app's lessons (lesson named) with their certainty. Owner facts: owner gear list, 2026-10-23. Tips are opinion.

guns.name: Tikka T3x Arctic
guns.sights: Open (iron) sights today: rear drum stepped 100 m to 600 m, front post. Picatinny rail ready for a scope.

facts.t: Calibre .308 Winchester, iron sights only today.
Barrel 508 mm (20 in), stainless, twist 1 in 10, two stage trigger, two position safety, Picatinny rail.
facts.s: Sako spec page, as carried in How a rifle works

facts.t: Your barrel: 20 in, confirmed by you 2026-10-23. Matches the factory 508 mm.
Open sights come zeroed at 100 m (109 yd) from the factory. Rear drum: six steps, 100 m to 600 m.
facts.s: Tikka T1x and T3x manual v5.3, as carried in How a rifle works

facts.t: Safety back is ON and locks the bolt closed. To unload the Arctic: muzzle safe, safety OFF, then lift the bolt.
facts.s: Tikka manual, as carried in How a rifle works

facts.t: Magazine capacity: 10 rounds per one retailer listing. VERIFY with your magazine.

lessons.label: How a rifle works: your Tikka T3x

guns.ammo: Tikka: your hunting load, about 20 rounds, all from the same lot
guns.ammoSrc: Season practice plan, range bag list (Tip)

care.t: Clean it right after use, even with no shots fired. Corrosion can begin within 24 hours, stainless too.
care.s: Tikka manual v5.3, as carried in Cleaning and maintenance

care.t: Wet: take it out of the case, dry it warm, then the routine clean.
care.s: Tikka manual v5.3, as carried in Cleaning and maintenance

care.t: Yearly service: at least once a year, more with heavy use, and before long storage. Includes copper fouling out and a bolt strip.
care.s: Tikka manual v5.3, periodic maintenance, as carried in Cleaning and maintenance

care.t: After cleaning, check the action screws (7 Nm with a metal trigger guard).
care.s: Tikka manual v5.3, as carried in Cleaning and maintenance

guns.name: CZ 457
guns.sights: Depends on the model. Scope base: 11 mm dovetail or a Weaver rail.

facts.t: Which CZ 457 model (variant) and chambering? Read the left side of the barrel and the box: VERIFY. The app builds for the whole CZ 457 family.
Scope mounts on an 11 mm dovetail or a Weaver rail.
facts.s: CZ 457 manual, as carried in The .22 rimfire

facts.t: Safety back shows a white dot and locks the trigger. The bolt opens with the safety ON, so unload with the safety ON.
facts.s: CZ 457 manual, as carried in The .22 rimfire

facts.t: Opposite habit to the Tikka. Say it out loud: Tikka, safety off to unload. CZ, safety stays on.
Magazines and barrels interchange with the CZ 455.
facts.s: CZ 457 manual, as carried in The .22 rimfire

facts.t: Stock screws: 3.5 Nm (newton metres).
facts.s: CZ 457 manual, as carried in The .22 rimfire

lessons.label: The .22 rimfire: accuracy, grouse and small game

guns.ammo: CZ 457: .22 rounds of the type your rifle groups best with, about 100 for practice

care.t: Clean it each time you use it. Wet: as soon as possible after shooting.
care.s: CZ 457 manual, as carried in The .22 rimfire

care.t: Clean at least once a year. After a great many rounds, a gunsmith cleans the bolt.
care.s: CZ 457 manual, as carried in Cleaning and maintenance

care.t: Rod and brush in from the chamber end, never the muzzle.

guns.name: SKS, Chinese
guns.action: Semi automatic, gas operated, fixed magazine
guns.sights: Open sights: front post, rear tangent leaf (Tip: check yours)

facts.t: Chinese SKS (Type 56 family), 7.62x39 mm. Surplus rifle, condition unknown.
Before the first shot: a gunsmith inspection. Firing pin moves freely, bore, headspace.

Magazine law: the 5 round limit for long guns applies to magazines made for semi automatic firearms. A fixed SKS magazine must hold no more than 5. A qualified gunsmith confirms or does any pinning. Never alter it yourself.
facts.s: How a rifle works, reading of SOR/98-462, Schedule, Part 4, s. 3, checked 2026-10-17

facts.t: Its federal class (non restricted or not) can change by regulation. Check the current RCMP (Royal Canadian Mounted Police) listing for your rifle: VERIFY.
Most surplus 7.62x39 ammunition has corrosive primers. Clean the same day you fire it.

lessons.label: Cleaning, maintenance, cold and wet weather

guns.ammo: SKS: 7.62x39 mm. Note if it is corrosive surplus

care.t: Corrosive ammunition fired: clean the bore, bolt, gas piston and gas tube the same day. Water based cleaner first, then oil.
Clean it after every range day.
Yearly: full field strip and clean, before long storage.

guns.name: Shotgun
guns.calibre: The app's pick: one 12 gauge, 3 inch chamber, screw in chokes
guns.action: Pump, semi auto or over under
guns.sights: Front bead. You point a shotgun, you do not aim it.

facts.t: Not owned yet. One 12 gauge with a 3 inch chamber and screw in chokes covers ducks with steel and upland birds.
Ducks and geese: non toxic shot only. Lead is legal for upland birds.
facts.s: Rule Book: legal methods, as carried in Shotgun mastery

facts.t: Pump or semi auto: a plug so the magazine holds no more than 2 shells, 3 in total with one in the chamber.

lessons.label: Shotgun mastery: chokes, patterns, shot sizes, lead

items.t: In or on a vehicle or boat in BC: never loaded. An ATV (All Terrain Vehicle) counts as a vehicle.
items.s: Firearm Violence Prevention Act s. 4(1), as carried in Firearm safety, At the car

items.t: Unloaded means no cartridge in the chamber and none in a magazine attached to or inserted in the gun. A full magazine clipped in with an empty chamber is loaded.
items.s: SOR/98-209 s. 1; BC synopsis definitions, as carried in Firearm safety and the Rule Book

items.t: Leaving the vehicle: rifles and shotguns locked in the trunk or a lockable compartment. No trunk: out of sight, vehicle locked.
items.s: SOR/98-209 s. 10(2), as carried in Firearm safety

items.t: Load only where you may lawfully shoot. Never on or across a road.
items.s: SOR/98-209 s. 15; synopsis page 10, as carried in Firearm safety

items.t: Boats: loaded only in a boat with no motor, or while the motor is not moving it, when hunting or retrieving wildlife.
items.s: Designation and Exemption Regulation s. 18, as carried in Firearm safety

items.t: At home: unloaded, and either a secure locking device, the bolt out, or a locked container or room that cannot readily be broken into.
items.s: SOR/98-209 s. 5(1), current to 30 September 2026, as carried in Cleaning and maintenance

items.t: At home: ammunition not readily at hand, unless it is locked up too. Tikka advises a separate locked place.
A suppressor is a prohibited device in Canada.
items.s: Criminal Code s. 84(1), as carried in How a rifle works

checklist.t: A safe backstop behind every target. At a range, use its berms and its rules. Outside a range: only where discharge is lawful.
checklist.s: Season practice plan: BC discharge bylaws and No Shooting Areas (Rule Book)

checklist.t: Ammunition for each gun you bring
Bolts and magazines with each gun, snap cap
Rest: sticks, sandbag or pad, and the pack you hunt with
Tools: scope tools and torque driver, cleaning rod with a bore guide, patches, oil
Journal and pencil. Log rounds and groups here after
Range hours, fees and rules checked before you drive
checklist.s: Season practice plan (VERIFY before you drive)

checklist.t: Unloaded in the truck, locked when you leave it. Read the transport card below.

items.name: A 12 gauge shotgun for birds (first pick)
items.why: Ducks, geese, grouse and quail. The rifle and the .22 cannot do ducks: they need shot.
pros: One gun covers waterfowl with steel and upland birds (70%, Choosing your shotgun).
Gas semi auto: softest recoil with 3 inch steel (70%, Choosing your shotgun).
Pump: cheapest and simple, cycles any load (70%, Choosing your shotgun).
cons: Another gun to store, lock and clean (Tip).
Pump kicks most; semi autos have more parts to clean (70%, Choosing your shotgun).
Many over unders are not rated for steel (65%, Choosing your shotgun).
